confluence.note: CONFLUENCE COUNT = integer count of independent pillars that fire, NOT a probability (analyzer refuses a single confidence number). A liquidity-pool confluence is CONTEXT — ICT RAW is net-negative, not a validated edge. More confluence != certainty; both scenarios stay valid only while invalidation holds.

projection.reason: target is down but invalidation 7558.25 sits at/below current 7600.25; no clean one-wave projection (not fabricated)

reliability: low-reliability (sub-1h; re-labels often — structure context, not a signal)
honesty: analyzer.py CANDIDATE read — counts are candidates, NOT predictions. Primary + alternative, each with its invalidation. The count is valid ONLY while its invalidation holds. Levels are the backbone; price breaking a level is the trigger, not the wave label.
subwave_note: Subwaves = ONE finer-degree ZigZag pass (lower-degree, lower-reliability — esp. sub-1h). Cap 2 degrees. A leg with no clean subdivision shows none (not invented).

recommendation.reason: no clean projected setup on the primary count — stand aside (the chart isn't offering a trade right now).

trendlines.basis: objective: lines anchored to analyzer ZigZag pivots, ATR-tolerance touch-counted, angle-filtered.
trendlines.honesty: COINCIDENT structure, not prediction. <3 touches = provisional (not validated). No channel without a real opposite-rail parallel. The CLOSE-break is the trigger, not the line. SHADOW — does not vote. Validated != proven-edge until forward-scored n>=30.
